{{MissingInfo|3|enva|java|janame}} :''Not to be confused with [[Jacq]].'' ---- [[File:Jacques.png|thumb|250px|Jacques]] '''Jacques''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP124|Snubbull Snobbery]]''. He is the head chef at [[Madame Muchmoney]]'s [[Palm Hills]] estate. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were dining with [[Madame Muchmoney]], she noticed that her {{TP|Madame Muchmoney|Snubbull}} refused to eat. She tried to have Jacques prepare something special for Snubbull, but he replied that he already tried everything before, and Snubbull still wouldn't eat. Fortunately, {{an|Brock}} gave Snubbull the [[rice ball]]s that he had in his [[bag]], and it ate them. {{-}}
